Foiley 1.1 rewrites the 3D viewport in Plane Design and 3D Analysis.

## 3D viewport

- The world-space orbit camera tracks a target, distance, yaw and pitch. It fits the mesh's bounding sphere when you select a plane, then holds the target and distance as you orbit. It starts in Z-up turntable mode and offers free trackball mode, perspective and orthographic projection, and wheel zoom toward the cursor.
- Standard navigation uses left-drag to orbit, right-drag to pan and the wheel to zoom. In CAD/Blender mode, use middle-drag to orbit, Shift + middle-drag to pan and Ctrl + middle-drag to zoom. Use 1, 3 and 7 for front, side and top, with Ctrl or Shift for the opposite view. Use 5 for projection, F to fit, G for the grid, and R or 0 to reset. Studio remembers the preferences.
- OpenGL draws the scene with a depth buffer through egui's glow paint callback. If viewport GL setup fails, Studio uses its CPU painter. `FOILEY_VIEW3D_CPU=1` forces the CPU painter.
- Ray picking selects a wing or body in Plane Design and shows panel pressure when you hover in 3D Analysis. The view includes a clickable orientation gizmo, toolbar, ground grid, and CoG, point-mass and neutral-point markers.
- Analysis overlays require a manifest matching the current geometry and, for mesh-based methods, the mesh hash. Renaming the plane, a wing, a body, a point mass or a foil is not a geometry change. When verification fails, the viewport shows the aircraft with a notice. Lifting-line plots use their own span stations.

## Fixes and checks

| Fix | Check |
|---|---|
| Plot selection uses the selected point's own deflected mesh | `plot-click.snap` |
| Replacing a polar updates the overlay and its GPU buffer key | `rerun.snap` for the CPU overlay. GPU buffer refresh not checked in OpenGL. |
| Ctrl + middle-drag zoom keeps its pivot | `ctrl-mmb.snap` |
| Fit preserves the current angle when it interrupts a view transition | `fit-interrupt.snap` |
| Shift + 1 selects the rear view | `rear-view.snap` |
| Keyboard shortcuts work with canvas focus | `egui_viewport_mmb_orbit_shift_pan_cad_preset_and_hotkeys` |
| Picking uses the same perspective clip planes as rendering | `off_axis_pick_respects_eye_space_near_clip` |
| Narrow-window rendering and picking share the same canvas | `narrow.snap` on CPU and `clipped_gl_canvas_keeps_its_projection` on GL rectangle math |
| Viewport depth storage no longer constrains the window format | Not checked on drivers with lower window depth. |
| Grid lines use premultiplied alpha in OpenGL | Not checked in OpenGL. |
| T6 and T7 base mesh verification runs in a worker and reuses the result | `base_mesh_hash_reuses_completed_work_and_ignores_obsolete_jobs` |
| Cancelling a base mesh verification does not hide deflected overlays | `cancelling_a_base_mesh_verification_does_not_hide_the_overlay` |
| Editing the plane name preserves framing | `rename.snap` |
| Renaming a plane, wing, body, point mass or foil preserves matching overlays, including in imported projects; a section switched to another foil does not | `renames.rs` and `renaming_a_foil_or_wing_keeps_the_analysis_overlay` |
| A 3D polar that finishes after a rename lands on the renamed plane | `a_polar_that_finishes_after_a_rename_lands_on_the_renamed_plane` |
| Undo and redo keep the selected plane and its framing | `undo_and_redo_keep_the_selected_plane_and_its_camera_fit` |
| Superseded mesh jobs add no Jobs rows or "cancelled" log lines | `superseded_background_jobs_are_hidden_and_not_logged` |
| The CPU painter batches panel edges with the faces, and skips edges above 20,000 panels as 1.0 did | `panel_edges_are_batched_with_the_faces` |
| `foiley snap` reports a plane without a wing, gives each run its own folder, and other commands keep exit status 2 for usage errors | `a_preset_that_needs_a_wing_reports_a_plane_without_one`, `runs_started_in_the_same_second_get_their_own_directories`, `usage_errors.rs` |
| `studio --run` previews the same aircraft it analyzes | `autorun.snap` |
| LLT results show stations and CoG with a valid manifest | `llt.snap` and `llt_overlay_draws_loads_at_the_solver_stations` |
| Clippy gate passes | `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` |

The snapshots were viewed on one Windows machine using the CPU painter
and WARP. The CPU painter sorts faces back to front, so intersecting faces
and occluded wake or lift lines can differ from OpenGL. Line antialiasing
also differs. These snapshots do not test the OpenGL pixels.

## Headless Studio captures from source

`cargo snap --preset views` writes PNGs, a contact sheet and a JSON
manifest. Scripts can drive the camera and record frame-by-frame traces.
Instructions and scripts reproduce the viewport checks.
[Viewport scripts](https://github.com/notmanan0/Foiley/tree/v1.1.0/docs/snap-review)

On Windows the optimized executable measured 15.86 MB without snap and
22.35 MB with it, so the published archives omit the snap feature.
